Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited. (2026-09-19). Government appreciation · Seven source letters. Pinnacle Verification Centre evidence summary. https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/appreciations.html

original The reviewed letters record appreciation and a recommendation for consideration of collaboration. The letter register identifies authors, dates and references. Appreciation is distinct from a licence, procurement contract, signed MoU or clinical endorsement. A recommendation for consideration does not mean the proposed agreement was executed. Original source: Recognitions bundle, physical pp2–8; cross-checked against September handout physical p13.
